name: Prophet Pariah
aliases: Prophet PariahProphet Pariah of the Lullaby Isles
desc:
A lunatic cult leader who originally wrote the Moonseye Tome. They were called 'Prophet Pariah of the Lullaby Isles'.

They lived a short life. In their own beliefs, they believed that there existed in the voidsea a so called stairway to [the heavens](location:the_heavens). With that thought, they navigated the voidsea until their presumed death.
additional_info:
-   Pariah likely believed the heavens to be the Moonseye and not Constellia due to the name 'Moonseye Tome', them being a Prophet of [The Moonlit Faith](faction:the_moonlit_faith) and the Moonseye in the cover within the tome.
-   A "pariah" is one who is considered an outcast.
